mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is positive, signaling a tightening cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters.
